Date November 17, 1938
S. C. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 8838
Date 18 / 11 / 38

(Special Branch) Office Notes

D. C. (Special Branch)

D.O. "A" was communicated with on November 16,
and after considering the circumstances surrounding the
disappearance of the girl's father, expressed the opinion
that a notice in the Chinese press would not serve its
purpose.

FILE
〔签名〕

〔签名〕 FILE
P.A. to D.C. (Sp.Br.)

FM. 23
G.4000-1-38

Divisional Office “ A ”
November 10, 1938.

Officer i/c. Louza.

On the face of it, it would appear the father of the
girl tried to lose her. In such cases I think a description
of the victim and a photograph should be inserted in the
Chinese press with a view to locating the parents or
relatives.

Sir,
In this case, the undersigned
is of the opinion that the girl
at the time of questioning
knew where she and her parents
were residing, but declined to
divulge their residence that
it would implicate her father
and bring about his arrest by the
Japanese. The girl herself answered questions
put to her very readily, but when asked to discribe
her temporary residence stated she could not. In view
of this, the undersigned thinks it not worth while
inserting discription in the press.

D.O. "A" Division.

〔签名 Robertson〕
Divisional Officer,
"A" Division.

〔签名 R. H. Campbell〕
S.I.

特别处处长

11月16日与“A”分区警官取得联系，在考虑了女孩父亲失踪的相关情况后，他表示认为在中文报刊上刊登启事达不到预期目的。

“A”分区办公室
1938年11月10日。

老闸捕房负责人。

乍看之下，似乎是女孩的父亲试图抛弃她。在此类案件中，我认为应在中文报刊上刊登受害人的体貌特征描述及照片，以便寻找其父母或亲属。

先生，
在此案中，卑职认为，该女孩在接受询问时知道她和父母的居住地，但拒绝透露，以免牵连其父并导致其被日本人逮捕。女孩本人非常乐意回答向她提出的问题，但当被要求描述其临时住所时，她表示无法描述。鉴于此，卑职认为不值得在报刊上刊登描述。

“A”分区警官。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. ________
                                Louza Station,
            REPORT              Date November 9th 1938.

Subject.... 'bandoned female disposed of through the S.S.D.Court.

Made by Sub-Inspt. Verndal.    Forwarded by [Signature]

Sir,

    For information, I beg to report the following:-
    At 4 p.m. 6/11/38, C.P.C. 368 brought to the Louza
Station, the undermentioned female, whom he found crying on Yu
Ya Ching Road near Chefoo Road, lost, namely:-
            Wong Ching (王菁), age 15 years, native of
Hangchow, S/female, N.F.A.
    Enquiries conducted by C.P.S. 1418 and the undersigned
elicited the following:-
    Father.    Song S Shang (宋士尚), age 45 years, native of
Hangchow, former Chief of Police, Shanse Provincial
Government, Headquarters, Sian.
    Mother.    Song Chang Sz (宋張氏), age 40 years, native of
Hangchow.
    Brother.   Song Siao Ma (宋小馬), age 12 years.
    Sister.    Song Siao Ling (宋小玲), age 7 years.
    Brother.   Song Siao Lieu (宋小柳), age 4 years.
    Following the outbreak of the Sino-Japanese hostilities,
the whole family fled to Hangchow, and took refuge with the
family of Song S Shang. It appears that Song S Shan has a brother,
named Song Ts Ling (宋子林), age 21 years, native of Hangchow.
Some time, current year, date not definitely known, this person,
Song Ching stated, was responsible for a certain bomb throwing
incident at Hangchow, directed against the Japanese. It was
learned, the girl stated, that as her father was a former
Government Official, and a relative of Song Ts Ling, they, the
Japanese, suspected he was concerned in the affair, and sought to
arrest him. The girl stated, her father decided the best thing
for him was, to leave the area, and, with the aid of a foreign
missionary, named "White", fled to Shanghai, arriving on or

上海公共租界工部局警务处。    档案号 ________
                                老闸捕房，
            报告              日期 1938年11月9日。

主题 ____ 通过上海第一特区地方法院处置的被遗弃女性。

由副督察 Verndal 制作。    由 [签名] 转呈

先生，

    谨报告以下情况供参考：-
    1938年11月6日下午4时，华捕368号将下述女性带至老闸捕房，该女子是在烟台路附近的虞洽卿路上被发现哭泣且迷路的，即：-
            Wong Ching (王菁)，15岁，杭州籍，单身女性，非英籍外人。
    经华探1418号及卑职调查，获悉以下情况：-
    父亲。    Song S Shang (宋士尚)，45岁，杭州籍，前陕西省政府西安总部警察局长。
    母亲。    Song Chang Sz (宋張氏)，40岁，杭州籍。
    兄弟。   Song Siao Ma (宋小馬)，12岁。
    姐妹。   Song Siao Ling (宋小玲)，7岁。
    兄弟。   Song Siao Lieu (宋小柳)，4岁。
    中日战事爆发后，全家逃往杭州，投奔 Song S Shang 的家族。据悉，Song S Shan 有一个弟弟，名叫 Song Ts Ling (宋子林)，21岁，杭州籍。据 Song Ching 称，今年某个时间（具体日期不详），此人应对杭州发生的一起针对日本人的投掷炸弹事件负责。据该女孩称，得知因其父曾是政府官员，且是 Song Ts Ling 的亲属，日本人怀疑他卷入此事，并试图逮捕他。女孩称，其父决定离开该地区为上策，并在一名名为“White”的外国传教士的帮助下，逃往上海，于

                                Station, ____
            REPORT              Date ____ 19
    Continuation Sheet No. 2.
Subject____
Made by____                Forwarded by____

October 30th, 1938.
    The girl stated that on arrival the whole family took
up residence in an hotel, and that it was the intentions of her
father to proceed to Szechuen, where he could join General
Chiang Kai Shek, with the aid of chartering a plane. To enable
him to achieve this, he must separate from his family.
    During the morning of the 6th inst, Song Ching stated,
that her father took her to the Sinceres Departmental Stores,
wherein he instructed her to look at the various goods on
display, whilst he was engaged in making various purchases. The
girl stated that her father at once moved out of sight and
disappeared. She tried to find out in what direction he had gone,
having failed to find him, wandered about the street until
picked up by the C.P.C.
    Upon learning the history of this case, the undersigned
communicated with the Special Branch, D.S.I. Logan & D.I. Pan
Lien Pih attended 2.30 p.m. 7th inst, and took particulars of
the case.
    Song Ching was taken before the S.S.D.Court, a.m. 9th inst
when an application for disposal was applied for. An order was
made for the girl to be detained in the National Child Welfare
Association Home, No.1231 Rue Lafayette, French Concession.
Handed over 10.30 a.m. 9th inst.
                        I am, Sir,
                    Your obedient servant.
                        R.H. Varnall
D.O. "A" Division.            Sub-Inspector.

Copy to Special Branch.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。    档案号 ____
                                捕房，____
            报告              日期 ____ 19
    续页第2号。
主题____
制作人____                转呈人____

1938年10月30日。
    女孩称，抵达后全家入住一家旅馆，其父打算包租一架飞机前往四川，以便投奔蒋介石将军。为了实现这一目标，他必须与家人分离。
    Song Ching 称，本月6日上午，父亲带她去了先施公司百货商店，让她观看陈列的各种商品，而他自己则忙着购买各种物品。女孩称，父亲随即离开视线并消失。她试图弄清父亲去向，因未能找到他，便在街上徘徊，直到被华捕发现并带走。
    获悉此案经过后，卑职与特别处联系，副督察长 Logan 和督察 Pan Lien Pih 于本月7日下午2时30分到场，记录了案件详情。
    Song Ching 于本月9日上午被提解至上海第一特区地方法院，当时提出了处置申请。法院下令将该女孩拘禁于法租界霞飞路1231号中华儿童福利协会之家。于本月9日上午10时30分移交。
                        先生，
                    您顺从的仆人。
                        R.H. Varnall
“A”分区。            副督察。

抄送特别处。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.
S.1, Special Branch, XXXXXX
REPORT
Date November 8, 1938.
Subject Statement by one Soong Jing (宋 璟 ), 15, female,
regarding her father Soong Tse-san (宋 子 山 ) alias
Soong Zoen-fang (宋 左 芳 ) believed wanted by Japanese
Made by D.S.I. Logan Forwarded by
Hereto attached is a statement made by a female,
namely Soong Jing, 15, daughter of Soong Tse-san, alias
Soong Zoen-fang, age about 45, native of Hangchow, formerly
Chief of Police, Sian, Shensi, concerning the latter, who
is stated to be wanted by the Japanese Military Authorities,
in connection with the activities of his brother Soong Tse-
ling (宋 子 林 ) who was killed while engaged with Chinese
Mobile Units in an attack on Japanese units, near Hangchow,
about the end of July, 1938.
It would appear that Soong Tse-san deserted his
daughter, above, in Nanking Road, on the forenoon of
November 7, 1938 in order to escape to Szechuen. The girl
was found by a C.P.C. and taken to Louza Station, from where
her disposal is being arranged through the Shanghai First
Special District Court.
D. S. I.
D.C. (Special Branch).
8/u.

由副督察长 Logan 制作 转呈人
兹附上名为 Soong Jing，15岁的女性所作陈述，她是 Soong Tse-san（别名 Soong Zoen-fang，约45岁，杭州籍，前陕西西安警察局长）的女儿，内容涉及后者，据称因与其弟 Soong Tse-ling (宋 子 林 ) 的活动有关而被日本军方当局通缉，其弟于1938年7月底左右在杭州附近与中国流动部队一起袭击日军部队时阵亡。
看来 Soong Tse-san 于1938年11月7日上午在南京路抛弃了上述女儿，以便逃往四川。女孩被一名华捕发现并带至老闸捕房，目前正通过上海第一特区地方法院安排对其处置。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT OF POLICE INVESTIGATIONS.

The following is the statement of Soong Jing ( 宋 琴 )
native of Hangchow taken by me D.S.I. Logan
at Louza on the 7/11/38 and translated by D. I. Fan
interpreted by Clerk Loh Wei-kong

My name is Soong Jing, alias Soong Siao-jing
( 宋 小 琴 ), female, age 15. I am a secondary school
graduate, daughter of a native of Hangchow, and was born
at Sian (capital of Shensi Province).
My father Soong Tse-san ( 宋 子 山 ), alias
Soong Zoen-fang ( 宋 善 芳 ) was the Chief of the Sian
Police Bureau between 1933 and April 1937, after which he
was transferred to Hangchow, to a post the nature of which
I do not know. I resided with my parents at 14 Fah Yuin
Hong ( 白 雲 巷 ), Ling Ying ( 彭 隱 ) District, Hangchow,
before the fall of that city.
Following the occupation of Hangchow by the
Japanese, I took refuge, together with my parents in
the countryside of Ling Ying District. My young uncle
named Soong Tse-ling ( 宋 子 林 ), alias Soong Zoen-zung
( 宋 善 成 ), aged 21, a middle school student, however,
joined the Chinese mobile units immediately after the fall
of Hangchow. He was killed on or about July 30, 1938,
during an attack which he made, with several of his comrades,
against the Japanese troops in the vicinity of Hangchow.
As the result of enquiries by the Japanese Military
Authorities into the movements of my father, we removed on
several occasions to various places in the Ling Ying
District. On October 18, we decided to leave that
district in view of strong rumours against my father.
A party of six persons consisting of my parents, my two
younger sisters, one younger brother and myself arrived

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
警方调查报告。

以下为 Soong Jing ( 宋 琴 ) 的陈述，杭州籍，由我副督察长 Logan 于1938年11月7日在老闸捕房录取，由 Fan 督察翻译，书记员 Loh Wei-kong 口译

我叫 Soong Jing，别名 Soong Siao-jing ( 宋 小 琴 )，女性，15岁。我中学毕业，父亲是杭州人，我出生于西安（陕西省省会）。
我的父亲 Soong Tse-san ( 宋 子 山 )，别名 Soong Zoen-fang ( 宋 善 芳 )，在1933年至1937年4月期间担任西安警察局局长，之后被调往杭州，任职性质我不清楚。在该城市沦陷前，我与父母居住在杭州彭隐区白云巷14号。
日军占领杭州后，我与父母一起避难于彭隐区乡下。然而，我的年幼叔叔名叫 Soong Tse-ling ( 宋 子 林 )，别名 Soong Zoen-zung ( 宋 善 成 )，21岁，中学生，在杭州沦陷后立即加入了中国流动部队。他于1938年7月30日左右，在与几名战友一起对杭州附近的日军发动袭击时阵亡。
由于日本军方当局对我父亲行踪的调查，我们多次搬迁至彭隐区的不同地方。10月18日，鉴于针对我父亲的强烈谣言，我们决定离开该区。一行六人，包括我的父母、两个妹妹、一个弟弟和我，抵达

- 2 -

on October 31 at the Hangchow Railway Station, where we
met a foreign missionary, namely, Miss Bah (白小姐), and
with her assistance we safely arrived in Shanghai at
about 10 p.m., November 1, though we were not in possession
of "Passes" issued by the Japanese Authorities.

Upon arrival here, we stayed in a hotel, the name
of which and its location I can not recollect. While
staying in this hotel, I never went out until November 7
at 7.45 a.m., when my parents brought us (six in all) out
to take a walk. On reaching a certain point, my father
told my mother and three children to wait there, and
further stated that he would accompany me to get some food.
After separating from my mother and two younger sisters
and brother, I accompanied my father. Upon reaching the
front of the Sincere Company Building, I discovered that
my father had disappeared. Every effort I made in the
vicinity of the building mentioned, failed to locate my
father. I was eventually brought to Station by a policeman
at 4 p.m. It is probable that my father may have left
for Szechuen and that he had the intention of deserting
me owing to shortage of money.

Logan

警务调查报告。

以下为本人____于____在____对____（籍贯____）所作的供词记录，并由____翻译

- 2 -

10月31日，我们在杭州火车站遇到了一位外国传教士，即白小姐（Miss Bah），在她的帮助下，尽管我们没有日本当局签发的“通行证”，我们仍于11月1日晚上10点左右安全抵达上海。

抵达此处后，我们住进了一家旅馆，但我已记不清该旅馆的名称及位置。在这家旅馆住宿期间，我一直未外出，直到11月7日上午7点45分，我的父母带我们（共六人）出去散步。走到某处时，父亲让母亲和三个孩子在那里等候，并进一步表示他将陪我去买点食物。与母亲、两个妹妹和一个弟弟分开后，我随父亲同行。走到先施公司大楼前时，我发现父亲不见了。我在上述大楼附近四处寻找，但未能找到父亲。最终，我在下午4点被一名警察带到警局。很可能父亲因缺钱而打算抛弃我，并已前往四川。

Logan
警官
